templates.name: Instant First Response
templates.text:
Hi [Buyer Name],

Thank you for reaching out! I've reviewed your request regarding [Project Focus]. With over 30 years of technology leadership and AI cloud architecture experience, I can certainly assist you in building a secure, production-ready solution.

To ensure I provide you with an exact technical scope and timeline, could you briefly share:
1. What document types or data sources need to be connected?
2. Do you have a preferred platform or cloud environment (AWS, Vercel, Docker)?
3. What is your ideal target delivery date?

Once you confirm these details, I will outline the recommended architecture and next steps. Looking forward to working together!

Best regards,
Alex | Enterprise AI Architect

templates.name: Explaining Third-Party API & Cloud Costs
templates.text:
Hi [Buyer Name],

To ensure total transparency before we begin: as is standard in enterprise software development, the monthly usage costs for third-party services (such as OpenAI/Anthropic API consumption, Pinecone vector storage, or AWS hosting) are billed directly to your own accounts.

During our build, I will implement smart prompt caching, chunking, and token guardrails to keep your operational API expenses as low as possible. I will also guide you step-by-step on how to set up usage caps and spending alerts in your API dashboards.

Please let me know if you have any questions on API billing!

templates.name: Proposing Paid Discovery Sprint
templates.text:
Hi [Buyer Name],

Thank you for sharing your project vision. Because your enterprise AI system involves [multiple data sources / multi-agent workflows / custom security requirements], proceeding straight to development without a validated architectural plan carries a high risk of scope misalignment and unexpected cost inflation.

I recommend starting with our **AI Scoping & Architecture Discovery Sprint ($250)**.

During this 2-day sprint, I will deliver:
1. Complete Technical Requirements Document (TRD)
2. Interactive System Architecture & Vector Pipeline Diagram
3. AI Model & Database Evaluation Matrix
4. Fixed-Price, Milestone-Based Implementation Roadmap

Once completed, the $250 discovery fee will be applied as a credit toward your full project implementation. Let me know if you would like me to send a custom offer for the discovery sprint!
